chunk_text: If the 10th lord from the ascendant is conjunct or aspected by the dispositor of Amatyakaraka or even conjunct or aspected by Amatya karaka himself, the native will be a chief in the king's court. Notes : Amatya karaka is the immediate successor of Atma karaka as we have seen earlier. The lord of the sign occupied by Amatya Karaka should aspect or join the 10th lord counted from the ascendant; the native will then enjoy a high governmental position. The Amatya karaka taking the role of his dispositor in the above case will as well yield similar effects.
